page_title: KOL 1-1 AUG | FC Koln v Augsburg 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90+7' Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg) is the one who receives a yellow card.
90+6' Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) picks up a yellow card.
90+6' The corner kick from Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+4' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Finn Dahmen stops the ball from going inside the left post.
90+2' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from FC Koln comes to nothing.
89' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
85' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
80' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Dominique Heintz and he is replaced by Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln).

79' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Finn Dahmen tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
77' Substitution. Fredrik Jensen makes his way off the pitch and Arne Engels (Augsburg) comes on as his replacement.
77' OFF THE POST! Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
76' Here is a change. Luca Waldschmidt is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln).
76' The referee signals a substitution. Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) is brought on as a substitute for Rasmus Carstensen.
74' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
72' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.
72' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

72' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
66' The substitution is prepared. Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mark Uth.
66' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Steffen Tigges is replaced by Davie Selke (1. FC Koln).
65' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
63' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg) replaces Niklas Dorsch.
63' The substitution has been made. Iago (Augsburg) has replaced Mads Pedersen.
63' Here's the change. Sven Michel leaves the pitch and Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
63' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
62' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
61' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The linesman makes the right call and FC Koln will have a corner.
59' Wonderful pass from Sven Michel (Augsburg) for Phillip Tietz, but they can't profit from it as Marvin Schwabe comes off his line to collect.
57' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
57' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) swings in a cross from the corner, but Finn Dahmen reads it well and gathers the ball.
56' Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln) picks up an injury.
55' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. FC Koln force a corner. They send men into the box.
55' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) shows good awareness inside the box to meet a delightful cross from the free kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
54' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
54' FC Koln will take a corner kick.

54' A pass into the box finds Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Finn Dahmen denies him. The ball goes out of play. FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
52' A lofted pass into the box is met by Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post.
51' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
51' Wow, what an escape. Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
50' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) whips in a cross from the corner, but Finn Dahmen is well positioned and punches the ball away.
50' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Now FC Koln have a corner.
49' Wonderful movement by FC Koln. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

48' Finn Dahmen was forced into action to thwart Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Robert Gumny (Augsburg) is replaced by Kevin Mbabu.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Finn Dahmen was alert and made a comfortable save.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

42' This should have been a goal! Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) takes a mid-range free kick and his effort flies straight as an arrow, but crashes against the crossbar. The keeper only turned his head and stared at the ball.
39' The referee can't ignore those comments and Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) sees a yellow card for bad language.
36' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
29' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
28' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
25' 1 - 1 Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home low into the middle of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
19' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) has a sight of goal and fires from the edge of the box, but his strike rattles the left post!
16' 1 - 0 Goal! Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
14' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) was too forceful with his tackle and Christian Dingert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
10' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
5' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) and Luca Waldschmidt combine well with some one-touch passing and are gradually building up to an attack.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Christian Dingert will referee today's match.
